inquiline.m: An animal that lives commensally in the nest, burrow, gall, or dwelling place of an animal of another species.

inquilines.m: More than one inquiline. inquiline: an animal that lives commensally in the nest, burrow, gall, or dwelling place of an animal of another species.

inquilinism.m: The situation where one animal lives commensally in the nest, burrow, or dwelling place of an animal of another species.

inquilinous.m: That lives in the dwelling place of another species.

inquisitional.m: Of or pertaining to an inquisition.

inquisitionists.m: More than one inquisitionist. inquisitionist: a member of an inquisition.

inquorate.m: That lacks the number sufficient to form a quorum.
